fields.conversion: Known [01] bits -> integer; any X/Z -> original bit string unchanged.
fields.definition: At a rising-edge pre-NBA sample with reset inactive, this is the current registered slot_note_on pulse consumed by the lane voice/ADSR Note On inputs on this edge. The pulse was asserted by nonblocking assignment after the preceding CTRL_ON && cmd_ready handshake edge H, not by the allocation edge. For a successful ALLOC_APPLY && slot_valid edge E, with no intervening reset abort, H is the first subsequent CTRL_ON && cmd_ready edge and consumption occurs at C=H+1. The earliest handshake is H=E+1 and the earliest consumption is C=E+2; CTRL_ON backpressure defers H and C. Source/channel/note/generation are the live registered lane identity committed at E. A Note On pulse does not itself imply sample_tick/advance_mask or a DDS phase reset.
